annotations.title: Work out a fitness test from the watch numbers

description: A fitness test worked out from the numbers the runner read off their watch after doing it (get_fitness_test says which). For each effort: the lap average pace (or speed), for a sprint also the fastest pace, and the average heart rate where there is one. Metabolic Lite also needs body mass, height, age and sex. It returns threshold pace and heart rate where measured, LT1 pace, FatMax, VO₂max, VLamax, economy, glycogen, predicted 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon times where the test gives them, every training zone, and how sure Sigwren is and why. Sigwren never fills a missing number in: a missing effort or body measurement is refused and named. A result from typed numbers is rated no higher than medium; uploading the recording (get_test_upload_link) lets Sigwren measure the efforts itself. Nothing is stored. It needs no account.

body.description: Metabolic Lite only: body mass, height, age and sex. Required there — Sigwren will not guess them.

efforts.description: One entry per effort, with the numbers the runner read off the watch.

avg_hr.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute. For a time trial, over the stretch get_fitness_test names (its last 10 or 20 minutes). Leave it out if there was no reading.

effort.description: Which effort: its id from get_fitness_test — sprint_a, sprint_b, e6min_a, e6min_b for Metabolic Lite; primary_effort for a time trial.

max_pace.description: Sprints only: the fastest pace within the sprint ("3:05").

max_speed_kmh.description: Sprints only: or the fastest speed within the sprint, in km/h.

pace.description: The lap average pace as minutes:seconds ("4:30"), per km or per mile as units says.

speed_kmh.description: Or the lap average speed in km/h, when the watch shows speed.

test.description: Which test: metabolic_lite, threshold_20 or threshold_30 (see get_fitness_test).

units.description: Whether the paces are per kilometre (the default) or per mile. The answer is in the same units.
